name: Astrid Lindström
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family of racers, but through her passion for automotive aesthetics. While studying industrial design in Stockholm, she was captivated by the intricate paint schemes and aerodynamic surfaces of racing cars. This led her to apprentice at a local custom car shop, where she honed her skills in color mixing, surface preparation, and paint application.

Her meticulous approach to paintwork is her signature. Astrid believes a flawless paint job isn't just about aesthetics; it's about creating a durable and aerodynamically efficient surface that can withstand the rigors of racing. She's particularly adept at applying complex multi-layered paint schemes and working with specialized coatings. Her ambition is to push the boundaries of automotive paint technology and contribute to Inter Europol Competition's competitive edge.

Astrid is also becoming a mentor for new team members, patiently showing them the best techniques, and ensuring quality control. She takes pride in her work, and she wants the entire team to be proud as well.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often with brightly colored extensions woven in.
physical.description: Astrid is slender with striking blue eyes and a playful, determined expression.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Has a specific playlist for each stage of the paint process.
Obsessively cleans her spray guns after every use.
